description.content: Trellis property contracts generated from Hono/Zod schemas.
Returns non-deleted Trellis properties for the authenticated workspace. Use `status` or `q` to narrow the result set.

query.description: Maximum number of items to return.
Case-insensitive search over name, internal code, and city.
